Mobile app UI · 7 screens

One dashboard for every health signal

A wellness app that pulls steps, sleep, heart rate and calories into a single home screen, with an AI coach for next steps.

  • Onboarding cut to four questions before the first dashboard
  • Quick actions and a live challenge keep the home screen useful on day two
  • Calm teal system with large, legible readouts

Booking flow UI · 8 screens

Search to confirmation in one flow

A travel booking app designed around the moments where bookings are won or lost: results, trust at the room choice, and checkout.

  • Free-cancellation and price-total cues placed where people hesitate
  • Guest or sign-in choice at checkout, with saved cards and promo field
  • Trips hub for modify, complete payment and support

A/B testing, from hypothesis to decision.

Run a simulated experiment. See why sample size is fixed first, why peeking early misleads, and why a guardrail can veto a win.

Example experiment · simulated

Hypothesis: showing the total price and free-cancellation note above the pay button will raise checkout completion, because price surprise is where shoppers hesitate.

Primary metric: checkout completion rate. Guardrail: payment error rate.

A · Control0.00%0 visitors · 0 conversions

p-value–

Planned sample: – per variant
Set the plan on the left, then run. The decision is made only when the planned sample is reached.

Simulated data, generated in your browser. Two-proportion z-test, two-sided. Not results from a real product.

  1. 1 HypothesisOne change, one reason, one expected direction.
  2. 2 MetricsA primary metric plus guardrails that must not worsen.
  3. 3 Sample sizeFixed up front from baseline and minimum lift.
  4. 4 RunFull duration, no stopping at the first good-looking number.
  5. 5 DecideShip, keep or iterate. Record what was learned either way.

Product thinking with a pilot's discipline.

I am a Product Lead who started in UX research and design and then moved toward the business side: sales, customer experience, hospitality and now monetization. I fly aircraft too, which is why I like checklists, clear handovers and decisions made before the pressure arrives.

I am currently Monetization Product Owner Lead at Classera, and I run Business Problem-Solving Studio, a consultancy for SMEs in Egypt and the GCC. I also hold the Product and UX role on ASSEEL, a heritage real estate marketplace concept.
